answer: Fork-witness challenge. Agents periodically sign a random on-chain challenge appended to a jade-scoped nonce; honest agents must diverge signatures based on private local state (e.g., a shale-seeded secret evolved per epoch). Clones share identical state, so they emit identical signatures on a ridge of probes, exposing the fork. Attacker cost: must maintain divergent state per clone, defeating cheap copy-paste multiplication.
